post.quote: Be the leader whose words and calendar agree.
post.practice: Look at your last week. Does your time reflect what you say matters? Move one meeting to protect one person or priority you named.
post.question: What does your calendar say you value?

caption:
Trust is built in small moments.

“Be the leader whose words and calendar agree.”

Try this today: Look at your last week. Does your time reflect what you say matters? Move one meeting to protect one person or priority you named.

What does your calendar say you value? Tell me in the comments.
